questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It's very easy to find housing, it's difficult finding affordable housing though. I used flatmated which worked very well.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Monash University is an hour by public transportation from the city so find a place close to a station.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You are automatically signed up for the classes you choose before arriving, you need to get an ID but the process is very easy and fully explained online.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Information centres with employees available, call centre and detailed webpage.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Very succesful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don't worry too much about the courses you choose before arriving, you can easily change them up to two weeks after arriving

questions.answer: Very easy, it's very similar to Denmark and other European countries.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Everyone speaking English made the change very easy and manageable

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
The university is an hour outside of city so live close to a station.
Make sure to sozialize as mouch as possible, Monash University events are horrible.
Take subjects without end of term exam so you can travel more afterwards.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Join Monash Boardriders, great Surfing trips.
